name: worktrees
description: Start branches, read CI, describe and merge pull requests, and prune finished worktrees through the worktrees CLI

interface.shortDescription: Branches, CI, pull requests and cleanup, through one CLI
interface.longDescription: Start a branch from the freshly fetched head branch, read a pull request's checks as compact JSON, keep its title and description true to its diff, merge it once CI is green and report what was fixed on the way, fast-forward the head branch, and remove the worktrees and branches the worktrees CLI proves finished, after asking.
capabilities: Read a pull request's CI checks as JSON, and wait for them
Check and correct a pull request's title and description
Fix failing checks, then merge with the repository's strategy
Start branches and fast-forward the head branch
Remove only the finished worktrees and branches you choose
defaultPrompt: Did CI pass on this pull request?
Merge pull request 42 once it is green.
Clean up the finished worktrees and branches here.
